request.system: You are a fraud analytics feature engineer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Existing provider features are grouped into families below. Propose new provider-level features that describe HOW a provider bills rather than HOW MUCH, because claim volume already explains most of the label. Use only the claim columns and provider bases the schema allows. Never use the label. Each existing feature is listed with its definition in the same operations you can use; do not propose an existing feature again, under any name or as an inverse. (Independent run 1, definitions.)

messages.content:
<data>
{
 "existing_features": {
  "size": {
   "n_claims": "provider base n_claims: number of claims",
   "n_ip_claims": "provider base n_ip_claims: number of inpatient claims",
   "n_op_claims": "provider base n_op_claims: number of outpatient claims",
   "n_bene": "provider base n_bene: number of distinct patients",
   "total_reimb": "provider base total_reimb: sum of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over all claims",
   "ip_total_reimb": "provider base ip_total_reimb: sum of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over ip claims",
   "op_total_reimb": "provider base op_total_reimb: sum of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over op claims",
   "n_attending": "provider base n_attending: number of distinct attending physicians",
   "n_operating": "provider base n_operating: number of distinct operating physicians",
   "n_other_phys": "number of distinct other physicians",
   "n_states": "provider base n_states: number of distinct patient states",
   "n_dgc": "provider base n_dgc: number of distinct diagnosis-related groups on ip claims",
   "n_admit_diag": "provider base n_admit_diag: number of distinct admission diagnosis codes"
  },
  "service_mix": {
   "has_ip": "1 if the provider has any ip claim",
   "has_op": "1 if the provider has any op claim",
   "ip_claim_share": "n_ip_claims / n_claims",
   "ip_reimb_share": "ip_total_reimb / total_reimb"
  },
  "money": {
   "reimb_per_claim": "total_reimb / n_claims (= mean of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over all claims)",
   "reimb_per_bene": "total_reimb / n_bene",
   "ip_reimb_mean": "mean of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over ip claims",
   "ip_reimb_max": "max of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over ip claims",
   "op_reimb_mean": "mean of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over op claims",
   "op_reimb_median": "median of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over op claims",
   "op_reimb_max": "max of InscClaimAmtReimbursed over op claims",
   "op_deductible_mean": "mean of OPDeductible over op claims",
   "zero_reimb_share": "share of all claims with InscClaimAmtReimbursed = 0 (1 - share_positive)"
  },
  "intensity": {
   "los_mean": "mean of los over ip claims",
   "los_max": "max of los over ip claims",
   "los_long_share": "share of ip claims with los of 10 days or more",
   "ip_claim_days_mean": "mean of claim_days over ip claims",
   "op_claim_days_mean": "mean of claim_days over op claims",
   "claims_per_bene": "n_claims / n_bene"
  },
  "coding": {
   "diag_per_claim": "mean of n_diag over all claims",
   "ip_proc_per_claim": "mean of n_proc over ip claims",
   "ip_surgery_share": "share_positive of n_proc over ip claims",
   "dgc_per_ip_claim": "n_dgc / n_ip_claims",
   "admit_diag_per_claim": "n_admit_diag / n_claims",
   "distinct_diag1_per_claim": "number of distinct primary diagnosis codes / n_claims"
  },
  "physicians": {
   "claims_per_attending": "n_claims / n_attending",
   "top_attending_share": "claims of the busiest attending physician / n_claims",
   "operating_present_share": "share of all claims naming an operating physician",
   "other_present_share": "share of all claims naming an other physician",
   "att_is_op_share": "mean (= share_positive) of att_is_op over all claims"
  },
  "duplication": {
   "dup_any_share": "mean (= share_positive) of dup_any_provider over all claims",
   "dup_same_share": "mean (= share_positive) of dup_same_provider over all claims"
  },
  "patient_mix": {
   "age_mean": "mean of age over all claims",
   "dead_share": "mean (= share_positive) of bene_dead over all claims",
   "n_chronic_mean": "mean of n_chronic over all claims",
   "renal_share": "mean (= share_positive) of RenalDiseaseIndicator over all claims",
   "bene_ip_annual_mean": "mean over all claims of the patient's annual inpatient reimbursement",
   "bene_op_annual_mean": "mean over all claims of the patient's annual outpatient reimbursement",
   "states_per_bene": "n_states / n_bene",
   "share_alzheimer": "share of all claims whose patient has Alzheimer",
   "share_heartfailure": "share of all claims whose patient has Heartfailure",
   "share_kidneydisease": "share of all claims whose patient has KidneyDisease",
   "share_cancer": "share of all claims whose patient has Cancer",
   "share_obstrpulmonary": "share of all claims whose patient has ObstrPulmonary",
   "share_depression": "share of all claims whose patient has Depression",
   "share_diabetes": "share of all claims whose patient has Diabetes",
   "share_ischemicheart": "share of all claims whose patient has IschemicHeart",
   "share_osteoporasis": "share of all claims whose patient has Osteoporasis",
   "share_rheumatoidarthritis": "share of all claims whose patient has rheumatoidarthritis",
   "share_stroke": "share of all claims whose patient has stroke"
  }
 },
 "operations": {
  "claim_aggregate": "mean, median, max, std or share_positive (share of claims with a value above 0) of one claim column, over all, ip (inpatient) or op (outpatient) claims",
  "ratio": "one provider base divided by another",
  "duplicates": "a proposal that restates an existing feature (the same aggregate or ratio, the inverse of a ratio, or a ratio that ranks providers the same way) adds no information and is rejected"
 }
}
</data>

claim_aggregates.name: agent_los_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Captures variation in inpatient length of stay, highlighting inconsistent billing patterns.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_claim_days_max
claim_aggregates.rationale: Measures the maximum duration of a claim, pointing to prolonged service intervals.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_n_diag_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Reflects the variability in the number of diagnoses per claim.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_deductible_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Measures dispersion in outpatient deductible amounts.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_age_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Describes the age diversity of patients served by the provider.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_n_chronic_max
claim_aggregates.rationale: Identifies claims involving patients with the highest number of chronic conditions.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_bene_dead_share
claim_aggregates.rationale: Proportion of inpatient claims associated with deceased beneficiaries.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_dup_any_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Variability in duplication flags across provider claims.

ratios.name: agent_bene_per_state
ratios.rationale: Measures geographic concentration of patient base.

ratios.name: agent_admit_diag_per_ip
ratios.rationale: Diversity of admission diagnoses relative to inpatient volume.

ratios.name: agent_dgc_per_bene
ratios.rationale: DRG complexity relative to the patient population size.
